parts.name: Handle
parts.Basic_description: The handle of the bucket is made of plastic and is attached to the upper sides of the bucket body. It is a curved rod-like part designed for carrying.
parts.Functional_description: The handle allows the user to lift and carry the bucket easily, distributing the weight evenly when filled with liquid or solid materials.
parts.Movement_description: The handle can rotate or pivot around its attachment points to the bucket body, allowing it to move up and down for carrying or resting positions.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: The base body of the bucket is a cylindrical container made of plastic, forming the main volume for holding materials.
parts.Functional_description: It serves as the main storage compartment for liquids, sand, or other materials, providing structural integrity and containment.
parts.Movement_description: The base body is a fixed, rigid part that does not move relative to the handle; it remains stationary during use.
